title: Consult applicable lessons before comparable engineering work
actor: An engineer or engineering agent preparing an activity
goal: Understand relevant prior learning and the current improvement disposition before undertaking comparable work.
context: The project retains lessons with stated contexts, but their applicability and adoption status differ.
trigger: The participant prepares work that may encounter a previously observed failure mechanism.
preconditions: The planned activity and its material context are identifiable.

interaction.action: Describes the planned work and requests relevant retained lessons.
Presents matching lessons with their supporting mechanism, applicability basis, exclusions, and current improvement disposition.
Examines differences between the planned context and the recorded conditions.
Identifies unresolved applicability and distinguishes proposed recommendations from adopted current practice.

expected_outcome: The participant can use relevant learning with its limits understood and without treating every recommendation as an authorized rule.

alternatives.condition: No relevant lesson is found within the available scope.
alternatives.outcome: The system reports no match and the examined scope without claiming absence of all possible lessons.

alternatives.condition: A material exclusion makes a candidate lesson inapplicable.
alternatives.outcome: The system explains the exclusion instead of recommending unconditional application.

failures.condition: Lesson sources or current adoption disposition are unavailable.
failures.outcome: The system identifies the unavailable information and does not report an adopted instruction.

failures.condition: The work context is too incomplete to assess relevance.
failures.outcome: The system reports unresolved applicability rather than an unsupported recommendation.

sources.basis: Analyzes IR-007 through a distinct stakeholder goal within the selected initial authoring profile; the owning IR records Scenario ownership. Accepted as current requirement-analysis knowledge after independent coverage and clarity review: one owning IR and primary Feature, observable goal and interactions, classified outcomes, and applicable SR coverage. This confirms analysis only, not requirement approval, implementation, or satisfaction.
